question: Dhimsa folk dance is performed by the tribes of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Araku Valley.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dhimsa** is a** traditional folk dance** of the tribes in the **Araku Valley** of **Andhra Pradesh.**
 
• The dance is performed by **women and men** in a group, and is usually accompanied by **tribal music and songs.**
 
• The dance is performed during **festivals and celebrations**, and is a way for the tribes to express their **cultural heritage and identity.**
 
• The Araku Valley region is known for its **natural beauty** and cultural significance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Solan Valley:**

 
 
• It is situated **14 km northwest **of the resort town of Manali, on the route to **Rohtang Pass**, this side valley at the summit of the Kullu Valley in Himachal Pradesh, India.
 
• It is well-known for its **summer and winter sports **conditions. 
 
 
 
• **Ketti Valley:**
 
 
• It is situated in **Tamil Nadu State's Nilgiris District.**
 
 
 
• **Parvati Valley:**
 
 
• The state of **Himachal Pradesh** in northern India is home to Parvati Valley.
 
• The Parvati Valley extends eastward through a steeply sided valley from the point where the** Parvati River** meets the **River Beas,** in the Kullu district of **Himachal Pradesh, Northern India**, starting in the town of Bhuntar.
